// doc: Repo-scoped VS Code settings, deployed from 0_apps/src/vscode. Machine/user preferences (theme, font, keybindings) do NOT belong here — only things that should hold for anyone opening this repo.
// generated-dirs: dist/ and .github/workflows/ are build OUTPUT (see 9_others and 9_others). Hiding them from search stops every grep returning the source and its 3 generated copies; they stay visible in the explorer so they can still be opened.
// readonly: dist/ is regenerated by build.sh; editing it directly is always a mistake and is silently overwritten on the next build.
// eol: Shell scripts and hooks are executed on Linux VMs; a CRLF checkout breaks the shebang line.
